title: JC-01 exact proposal only, not installed

TypedPublication.description: Typed publish Human binding companion, not the ordered history receipt; the exact new receipt shape is TypedHistoryReceipt.

BoundNotesProjection.description: Minimum display strings derived from the bound original row; absent cells null, numeric manual hints displayed as strings. Escape text; redact secrets/absolute paths. Never mutate raw cells or upgrade evidence.

semantic_checks_required: No untrusted SourceRef path resolution: original role-specific Readers only, no traversal/symlinks/foreign scope
The original signed command must be v1.6; old tokens cannot authorize a type decision
Type choice and exact safe display are part of one signed pre-approval snapshot and explicit Human action
First formal type decision resolves actual persisted Case Approval SHA and proves its exact candidate transition
Null choice is explicit; unknown cannot be a formal type; other note is non-whitespace and private
Original evidence/quality/privacy/source/cover validators remain mandatory; schema shapes never grant them
Current Reviewer grant and original operation replay checks; independent three receipts, never future SHA prediction
Current type/publication head wins; revoked/changed type or withdrawn latest publication cannot revive older publication
Case/Type saved stages survive failures, only missing steps resume against original consent; no new Task/Approval/Publication on replay
Joint type operation ID is type_<human operation hex>; standalone Identifier grammar must not be applied to the 32-hex original command ID

JointTypeDecision human_command resolves the original durable signed v1.6 intent, same actor, Case/Attempt, exact chosen type/catalog/private note and preview; a matching operation name alone cannot authorize it

Shared v1.2 Reader validates standalone v1.0 and joint v1.1 type decision versions explicitly. A joint record must resolve the same Human command and actual committed Approval transition; no unknown-version fallback
